ui.completedSubtitle: Your computer skills have been evaluated.

tasks.title: Move Cursor
tasks.instruction: Move the cursor into the blue circle.

tasks.title: Hover
tasks.instruction: Keep the cursor inside the purple square for 2 seconds without clicking.

tasks.title: Single Click
tasks.instruction: Left click the orange square once.

tasks.title: Double Click
tasks.instruction: Double-click quickly with the left mouse button on the teal circle.

tasks.title: Right Click
tasks.instruction: Click the amber rectangle using the right mouse button.

tasks.title: Click and Hold
tasks.instruction: Press and hold the left mouse button on the red circle for 2 seconds.

tasks.title: Drag and Drop
tasks.instruction: Click and drag the blue square into the target frame.
